newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican hog producers to launch pork campaign.
newsitem.headline: Mexican hog producers to launch pork campaign.

text.p: Mexico's National Hog Producers Commission (Conapor) is to launch a campaign to boost pork consumption, state-owned news agency Notimex said.
Conapor chairman Antonio Canaan Sasia told Notimex the campaign would aim to halt and reverse the national trend of lower pork consumption.
He gave no additional details about the campaign, including when it would start.

Canaan said the campaign idea came up at a recent Conapor meeting in Jalisco state and added it would start alongside a new drive to clamp down on illegal imports of pork meat and pork by-products from the United States.
